label: r4c3
name: yflip, ent 0.01 + global context
hypothesis: Takes the best net (ent_coef 0.01) and adds a full-scale Linear projection of the pooled global features into every cell's head pre-activation. Placement logits can then use board-wide progress. The change costs almost no FLOPs and reached 0.86 training success at entropy 0.002, the highest at that setting. Dev above 0.92 supports it. Dev below 0.85 means the global term adds noise to local placement decisions.
